{{CharInfobox| color={{crystal color}} | corecolor={{crystal color light}} | bordercolor={{crystal color dark}} | name=Molly Hale | jname=ミー・スノードン | tmname=Me Snowdon | slogan=no | image=Molly Hale.png | size=299px | caption=Molly Hale| gender=Female | hometown=[[Greenfield]] | region=[[Johto]] | relatives=[[Spencer Hale]] (father), Unnamed mother | age=yes| years=5| trainer=no | game=no | leader=no | team=no | brain=no | anime=yes | epnum=M03| epname=Spell of the Unown: Entei| enva=[[Amy Birnbaum]]| java=[[List of Japanese voice actors|Akiko Yajima]]| }} '''Molly Hale''' (Japanese: '''ミー・スノードン''' ''Me Snowdon'') is a little girl from [[Greenfield]], and the daughter of researcher [[Spencer Hale]]. She is the main antagonist of ''[[M03|Spell of the Unown: Entei]]''. ==In the movies== [[File:Molly Hale teen.png|thumb|250px|left|Molly under the spell of the Unown, as an 18-year-old]] Sometime before the events of the film, Molly's mother disappeared, supposedly because of [[Spencer Hale|Spencer]]'s research (in the Japanese version, her absence was never directly explained, although guidebooks released with the movie revealed that she had been hospitalized before the events of the film). Spencer was left to care for Molly, but because his job requires an undying commitment, she was often left under the care of the servants and housekeepers. At the beginning of the {{pkmn|movie}}, Molly was read tales of [[Legendary Pokémon]] by her father. She stated that {{p|Entei}} was her favorite Legendary Pokémon because it reminded her of her father. Spencer abruptly left after receiving an email involving his research. When her father later disappeared into the [[Unown Dimension]], Molly was left in the care of the family servants. Before he vanished, her father left behind a mysterious puzzle box with {{OBP|Unown|M03}}-shaped letter tiles. Upon receiving the box, Molly used the tiles to spell "Mama" and "Papa", the people she truly desired. When she began to cry, the Unown sprung to life and granted her wish, summoning an {{OBP|Entei|M03}} who was led to believe it is Molly's father. The Unown started to reflect Molly's confusion, anxiety, fear, and loneliness with their {{m|Hidden Power}}, slowly engulfing her mansion and then her hometown, [[Greenfield]], with crystal, driving everyone but Molly away. Molly decided she needed a mother as well, and had the Entei bring {{Delia}} to her after seeing her on television. Upon being confronted by Entei, Delia was hypnotized into believing that she was the girl's true mother and was taken to the mansion. However, the hypnosis was eventually broken when Delia saw her son {{Ash}} risking his life while trying to enter the crystallized mansion. Since that moment, Delia tried to reason with Molly, helping and protecting her throughout the movie. Molly became inspired by seeing Ash use his Pokémon to enter the mansion and decided that she wanted to be a [[Pokémon Trainer]]. She fell asleep, and Entei left to greet Ash and his friends, bringing along a dream-version of Molly. Molly wished she were older so that she might be a Trainer, and she turned into a teenager. [[File:Molly Hale pre-teen.png|thumb|250px|As a 10-year-old]] She greeted Ash and his friends and challenged them to a battle. {{an|Brock}} volunteered to battle her so that Ash and {{an|Misty}} could continue on and find Delia. After Brock's defeat, she met up with Ash and Misty further ahead. After realizing Misty, who was younger than her teenage form, was a Trainer as well, she changed to a preteen and challenged Misty to a battle while Ash went ahead. Once Ash reached Delia, they woke up the real Molly and asked that she escape with them. When Delia revealed that she was leaving, Molly was left heartbroken, and her emotional turmoil caused the Unown to lose some control. Entei appeared to defend her, but after a gruesome battle between him and [[Ash's Charizard]], Molly realized what her wish was doing to those around her, and she agreed to end the illusion and return to reality. This caused the Unown to completely lose control of their psychic concentration. They reached the Unown's chamber and Entei sacrificed himself to drive away the Unown, returning the land and manor to normal. At the same time, the Unown returned to their ruins, returning Spencer from their dimension in the process. He returned to the manor and reunited with his daughter. After some time, Molly received a real Pokémon, a {{p|Teddiursa}}. While playing with it one day, her father appeared with her mother by his side, leaving Molly overjoyed. Molly briefly reappeared in a montage in ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]'', which chronicled the preceding nine movies. ===Character=== With her mother having disappeared several years prior (or having been hospitalized, depending on the version) and [[Spencer Hale|her father]] busy with his work schedule, Molly had become increasingly lonely and withdrawn. Her father's own disappearance only exacerbated this loneliness. The {{OBP|Unown|M03}} gave Molly the opportunity to live out her wildest fantasies and idealized reality, which appeared to have originated from the fairy-tales her father read to her, twisted together with her strong emotions. From a psychological standpoint, Molly's decision to have [[Greenfield]] become a crystal wasteland and surround herself with Pokémon was indicative of her distrust for people. Molly also expressed strong ambitions to become an extremely strong [[Pokémon Trainer]]. As such, she battled both {{an|Brock}} and {{an|Misty}} with Pokémon possessing abnormally high levels of strength. She also took on physical appearances that she believed to be more befitting of a Trainer, though she retained her childish personality. Molly eventually came to realize that she can achieve her true desires in real life, and this led the Unown to disappear. Her newly acquired {{p|Teddiursa}} is representative of this change. ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} ====On hand==== Molly battled Ash, Misty, and Brock with dream Pokémon manifested by Entei. However, she was only shown with one real Pokémon, a Teddiursa. {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Molly Hale |pkmn=Teddiursa |type1=Normal |img=Molly Hale Teddiursa Real.png |epnum=M03 |epname=Spell of the Unown: Entei |desc=Molly was shown to have a {{p|Teddiursa}} at the end of the movie. It is unknown where and when she obtained it. None of Teddiursa's moves are known.}} ====Illusion Pokémon created by the Unown==== Due to being Pokémon created through Molly's dreams, these Pokémon were a lot stronger than real ones, as stated by {{an|Brock}}. {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Molly Hale |pkmn=Flaaffy |type1=Electric |img=Molly Hale Flaaffy.png |epnum=M03 |epname=Spell of the Unown: Entei |vaen=Kayzie Rogers |desc={{p|Flaaffy}} was the first Pokémon Molly used in her battle against {{an|Brock}}. Brock sent out his {{TP|Brock|Zubat}}, who quickly used {{m|Supersonic}}, leaving Flaaffy {{status|confusion|confused}}. After Zubat's failed follow-up attack, Flaaffy finished the battle with a Thunder Shock. Flaaffy's known moves are {{m|Headbutt}} and {{m|Thunder Shock}}.}} {{anchor|Teddiursa 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Molly Hale |pkmn=Teddiursa |type1=Normal |img=Molly Hale Teddiursa.png |epnum=M03 |epname=Spell of the Unown: Entei |vaen=Tara Jayne |desc={{p|Teddiursa}} was the second Pokémon Molly used in her battle against {{an|Brock}}. Brock started off by commenting on how such a cute Trainer had a cute Pokémon. Teddiursa started the battle by using Dynamic Punch against [[Brock's Vulpix]], which greatly damaged it. Vulpix attacked with {{m|Quick Attack}}, and Teddiursa used Fury Swipes, resulting in Teddiursa's win. Teddiursa's known moves are {{m|Dynamic Punch}} and {{m|Fury Swipes}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Molly Hale |pkmn=Phanpy |type1=Ground |img=Molly Hale Phanpy.png |epnum=M03 |epname=Spell of the Unown: Entei |vaen=Tara Jayne |desc={{p|Phanpy}} was Molly's third and final Pokémon used in her battle against Brock. It made quick work of [[Brock's Onix]] with a Rollout. Phanpy's choice was a pun on Brock saying earlier that he likes to "rock and roll" his Onix being the rock, and Phanpy being the roll. Phanpy's only known move is {{m|Rollout}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Molly Hale |pkmn=Kingdra |type1=Water |type2=Dragon |img=Molly Hale Kingdra.png |epnum=M03 |epname=Spell of the Unown: Entei |desc={{p|Kingdra}} was the first Pokémon Molly used in her battle against {{an|Misty}}. After Molly raised the water to flood the field, she summoned her Kingdra. It started off by using Smokescreen, and then Headbutt. After [[Misty's Goldeen]]'s failed {{m|Fury Attack}}, Kingdra won the battle. Kingdra's known moves are {{m|Smokescreen}} and {{m|Headbutt}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Molly Hale |pkmn=Mantine |type1=Water |type2=Flying |img=Molly Hale Mantine.png |epnum=M03 |epname=Spell of the Unown: Entei |vajp=Katsuyuki Konishi |desc={{p|Mantine}} was Molly's second Pokémon used in her battle against {{an|Misty}}. Mantine attacked [[Misty's Staryu]] with a Whirlpool, trapping Staryu in a vortex. After Staryu escaped with a {{m|Rapid Spin}}, it charged at Staryu's Tackle with a Take Down. The rest of the battle took place off-screen, leaving the outcome unknown. Mantine's known moves are {{m|Tackle}}, {{m|Bubble Beam}}, {{m|Whirlpool}}, and {{m|Take Down}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |main=Entei (M03) |trainer=Molly Hale |pkmn=Entei |type1=Fire |img=Entei M03.png |epnum=M03 |epname=Spell of the Unown: Entei |vajp=List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Naoto Takenaka |vaen=Dan Green |desc=Entei was a physical manifestation created by the Unown of Molly's desires for companionship. He is an illusionary Entei that appeared to Molly after she made a wish to the {{OBP|Unown|M03}}. He served as a replacement father for her while her real father, [[Spencer Hale|Spencer]], was trapped in the [[Unown Dimension]]. When {{Ash}} attempted to confront Entei to get his mother back, his {{AP|Totodile}} and {{AP|Cyndaquil}} were rapidly defeated, with {{AP|Pikachu}} only lasting longer without faring any better, and even {{AP|Charizard}} — who had witnessed the incident on television at the [[Charicific Valley]] and came to help — was only able to hold Entei off without actually defeating it. However, when Entei was about to break Charizard's neck, Molly finally decided that she wanted things to be real again.}} ===Artwork=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; font-size: 80%; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{crystal color dark}}; background: #{{crystal color}};" |- | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{crystal color dark}}; background: #{{crystal color light}}; width:130px; height:170px"| [[File:Molly Hale artwork.png|150px]] |- | Artwork from the {{color2|000|Game Freak}} website |} ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{crystal color}}|bordercolor={{crystal color light}} |ja=矢島晶子 ''Akiko Yajima'' |en=[[Amy Birnbaum]] |cs=Jana Páleníčková |de=Sabine Bohlmann |fi=Outi Alanen |fr_eu=Carole Baillien |is=Kristrún Hauksdóttir |it=Giovanna Papandrea |pt_br=Christiane Monteiro |pt_eu=Sandra de Castro |es_eu=Ana Esther Alborg |es_la=Alondra Hidalgo
